map.NPV = −1000+300/1.1+400/1.21+500/1.331 ≈: NPV = −1000+300/1.1+400/1.21+500/1.331 ≈ −20.9. Slightly negative, meaning it is marginally not worthwhile at a 10% discount rate; the critical IRR is about 9.7%.

map.折现率怎么定？: How should the discount rate be set?
map.用要求回报率或资本成本 WACC；越高 NPV 越低，是灵敏度关键变量。: Use the required rate of return or the cost of capital (WACC); the higher it is, the lower the NPV, making it the key sensitivity variable.
map.NPV 和 IRR 为什么会给出相反结论？: Why do NPV and IRR sometimes give opposite conclusions?
map.两者的再投资假设不同：NPV 假设期间现金流按贴现率再投资，IRR 假设按 IR: Their reinvestment assumptions differ: NPV assumes interim cash flows are reinvested at the discount rate, IRR assumes reinvestment at the IRR itself. Conclusions may conflict for mutually exclusive projects or when the timing of cash flows differs greatly; NPV is usually the tie-breaker.

Criteria: no fixed grading (the page only outputs the NPV number); NPV > 0 means the project creates value at that discount rate and < 0 means it destroys value.
